run.procedureSummary:
Start: forms 1-6 = 3,6,6,2,2,1, all GREEN, waste 0. Each cycle, steps in order, each step applied to all six forms before the next:
1. Charge: add the cycle's charge-sheet row to each form; no trimming.
2. Overtop: walk forms 1 to 6 in turn; any amount over capacity (10,8,12,6,9,7) moves into the next form before that form is checked; form 6's excess goes to waste.
3. Marks: GREEN with quantity >= upper mark (7,6,9,5,7,5) becomes HOT; HOT with quantity <= lower mark (3,2,4,2,3,2) becomes GREEN; otherwise no change; log each change.
4. Bleed: take a snapshot of all six quantities and states, then apply all moves at once: GREEN loses floor(q/4) to waste; HOT loses floor(q/2) to the form before it (form 1's HOT bleed goes to waste). No trimming afterwards.
5. Washout: if the line total is over 38, every form becomes floor(q/2) and the difference (total minus new total) goes to waste; if the total is 38 or less, nothing happens.
Report after cycle 5.

openPoints.point: Washout rounding: 'halve every form, rounded down' could mean the form keeps floor(q/2) or that floor(q/2) is removed (so the form keeps ceil(q/2)).
openPoints.assumption: The form keeps floor(q/2). The remainder, ceil(q/2), goes to waste.

openPoints.point: Bleed uses quantities from before or after other forms' moves.
openPoints.assumption: All bleed amounts come from a snapshot taken after Marks ('Read all six first'), so what a form receives from the form after it does not change what it loses.
The state after this cycle's Marks step.

openPoints.point: A HOT bleed pushing the form before it over capacity.
openPoints.assumption: It is not trimmed. The excess carries into the next cycle's charge, as the write-up says. For example, form 2 ends at 10 against a capacity of 8.
38 is not over 38, so no washout. This applied in cycle 5, where the total was 38.
Excess is added to the next form before that form's own capacity check, so it can cascade. Form 6's excess goes to waste at once.

openPoints.assumption: All forms start GREEN, as stated. States carry over between cycles.
